whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Vyanjan Vihar,

I noticed your restaurant has solid 4.2★ reviews on Khagaul Rd in Phulwari Sharif, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online orders and table bookings.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table reservation, aur special dishes integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/vyanjanvihar

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team Vyanjan Vihar, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Vyanjan Vihar) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering and a mobile-friendly showcase right on Khagaul Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual food photos aur pricing setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
